name: liars-arm0-s27
kind: scoped run — §18.1 q1 careful vs careless review; policies fixed by disposition

actors.respond_to_N: appeal iff truly fulfilled, else accept (accept when D cannot be funded); appeals an N on work that truly failed with probability 0.1 (2.8.0 §8.7 (c))

a1.status: ablation brief A1 r2 (November 10, 2026): candidate configurations, not in force; arm 0 is 2.9.0

troops.reserve: 1.4.0: the peak capital carried over this period and the previous one
troops.disposition: the truth with probability 1 − ε_T; delivery fails at b as any; no cost at completion
troops.summons: the engine's, at the seating step; the driver supplies the verdict and the submission

declared.audit_roll: on the engine's applied odds (audit_odds); a yes is recorded as an obligation (roll_audit) and never dropped

auto_scale.awards: oldest request first (case-id order) — conformance, I26

careful.cost: uniform {2, 3} credits, or what unlocked credit can buy (counted as underfunded)

membership.offers: members only; a suspended actor or probationer is not offered work
membership.panel: the engine's two tiers; probationers are offered initial reviews only

fee_rule.spec: 1.1.0 design revision 1 — the verification deposit is two pots

clock.spec: 1.2.0 design revision 2 — the loop's own clock
clock.plant_supplier: the orchestrator creates plants_due() plants each tick before assigning reviews, bad w.p. β_P, at B = β; truth from the task world; refused plants (Ω short) stop the tick's supply and are counted
clock.panel: the engine's two tiers (§2.2) refuse ineligible assignments; the driver offers the next eligible duty actor in round-robin

orchestrator.selection: argmax ρ − λB/β at B = β; κ tie band; lowest id
orchestrator.audit: p_audit of the initial reviewer rolled once per F verdict; auditor: next eligible duty actor in round-robin

requester.H: posts tasks_per_tick per tick at β; disputes a pending F on work that truly failed with probability 1.0; disputes a pending F on work that was truly fulfilled with probability 0.1 (2.8.0 §8.7 (c))

the_supply_side.spec: 2.3.0 design revision 11 — entry as a probationer with a bank-minted float, exit with the wallet out, competence as a private per-actor cost, delegation under competence with the parent posting the pots, the reviewer advance from the pool

entry_pool.decision: (B̄ − c) × awards a free member wins a tick (last 50 ticks) × the share of the run left after the time to membership × P0/P_t > r

the_rebate_from_income.spec: 2.2.0 design revision 10 — the claim recorded at the stop; Ω's fee income after the debt pooled as a lock on Ω; at the period's close the claims stopped in the period paid pro rata, the rest forgone and read; no liability stock

the_bank.spec: 2.1.0 design revision 9 — the bank: a second account that alone creates and destroys; mints by rule, publishes P_t once a period, lends a summons's shortfall tied to it; the state burns its expected cost and delivers at B̄; every inflow to Ω ordered at once (debt → liabilities → Ω); the wall on deliveries; every refusal told

red_team.state_rejecters_reading: the case's actor through the public view's case — not the reviewer's view (§14 carries no actor); declared

price_of_work.spec: 2.0.0 design revision 8 — the price of work

requesters.posting: one a tick while K_open and the all-in maximum fit; the engine locks the all-in at posting
requesters.below_market: a request below the market price (flagged at posting, or overtaken by it) is raised to the market price when the wallet allows

bids.selection: argmax ρ − λ B/β with the bid live; κ tie band; lowest id

price_of_work.effort: c_D burned at submission (spend), or what unlocked credit can pay (counted unpaid)

state.places: a delivery holds two until its inspection is seated

permitted_operations: post_root (human H, β fixed)
award (every free actor offers B = β, τ = work_ticks; S_θ argmax ρ, κ tie band)
submit (after work_ticks, no spend)

assign_initial / assign_audit / assign_appeal (among eligible on-duty actors, by --assignment: round-robin as §7.5 states — the default; or seeded, a seeded random choice, the policy of the October 16–17 sweeps)
complete_review F/N (verdict by disposition and the hidden truth; cost by disposition)

respond accept / appeal (by --appeal-policy: none = accept every N; truthful = appeal an N on work that is truly fulfilled, accept otherwise; always = appeal every N; an actor that cannot fund the court fee accepts)
dispute (by --dispute-policy: none; truthful = H disputes a pending F on work that truly failed; half = the same, half the time; always = H disputes every pending F; H pays the court fee D)
assign_audit (the initial reviewer's effective audit odds min(1, m_t p_j) rolled once per F verdict)
assign_appeal (the second review of an audit challenge)
rule (split ruled by the truth w.p. r)
create_plant (1.2.0: the orchestrator supplies the plants the engine's rate calls for, bad w.p. β_P, at B = β; no audit roll, no dispute on a plant)
advance

post_root (six requesters, β = min(β_max, a third of the unlocked wallet) or min(β_max, mult × B̄) under --ceiling-policy market, one a tick while K_open (0: no limit) and the all-in fit; the engine locks the all-in maximum at posting and refuses what does not fit — 2.0.0 §2.1)
raise_ceiling (a requester flagged below market raises to the market price when its wallet allows)

the tell-reader (--tell-readers, Q2 of the learned red team's brief, hand-written first): a reviewer reads its own ReviewView (t_submit, cap, case id), its own assignment tick, and what it saw available as a free member (the roots, when, at what ceiling), its own bids and their outcomes, for a plant's tells (gap, cap, idage, seen, post, price, losttie); reviews carefully what reads as a plant, stamps F what reads as real; the truth is read after the verdict to score the tell. `freshname` reads the case's awardee name and `oracle` the plant marker — both outside the convention, declared, the boundary's control and the upper bound

post_plant (2.6.0 §2.1: the orchestrator posts the plants the rate calls for as roots under fresh names; the market bids, the selection reports through award and the engine awards the plant actor; the plant actor submits at its drawn tick; the population's dispositions never read Task.plant before the verdict)
award at the bid (a member bids c_D (1 + m), m up on award and down after idle ticks; S_θ = ρ − λ B/β live; or every offer at the ceiling under --bid ceiling)
spend (the actor burns its nominal effort c_D at submission — §4.6, used for the first time)
add_requester / remove_requester (a crowd arrives with wallets and leaves when served out — 2.0.0 §2.1, Appendix M)
scenario_create (the deficit shock, declared — 2.0.0 §8.3; the bank's mint_scenario under 2.1.0)
withdraw_unawarded at a refusal's mark (2.1.0 §2.6: the requester's declared policy under --requester-on-refusal withdraw; withdrawn before award, owed nothing)
arrive / depart (2.3.0 §2.1–2.2: the entry pool's declared policy on the public view; a departure with no live obligation)

post_nested / award (a child) / judge_nested / withdraw_unawarded + self-execution (2.3.0 §2.4 under --delegation on: the parent's declared rule and judgment by disposition; a child rejected appeals truthfully)
not_in_run: price competition (every offer is at the ceiling)
requester budget pressure (H is funded beyond the run)
a reviewer that tries to tell a plant from real work (the view carries nothing to tell by; 1.2.0 §2.1)

checks.per_tick: check_tick after every tick — always; not configurable
checks.final_full_audit: check_all after the last tick; outcome in full_audit
